hook.en: A gentle pull that separates joint surfaces to reduce compression and test or calm symptoms.
hook.ur: Manual traction ya joint distraction mein joint ko controlled direction mein ahista kheench kar compression-sensitive symptoms ka response dekha jata hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll know what Manual Traction & Joint Distraction is, when it's safe and useful, how to apply it step by step — and how to prove it worked. (3 checks along the way.)
goal.ur: End tak aap jaan jayenge ke Manual Traction & Joint Distraction kya hai, kab safe aur faida-mand hai, qadam ba qadam kaise apply hoti hai — aur kaise prove karein ke kaam kiya. (Raste mein 3 checks.)

text.en: Manual traction is a hands-on pull along the length of a limb or spine (distraction means pulling the joint surfaces apart). It is used either to relieve pressure and pain or, with more force, to stretch tight joint tissue.
text.ur: Joint ko long-axis ya us ki specific direction mein distract kiya jata hai, taake compression kam karne, symptoms modulate karne ya unloading ka response test karne mein madad mile.

simpler.en: A gentle pull that separates joint surfaces to reduce compression and test or calm symptoms.
simpler.ur: Manual traction ya joint distraction mein joint ko controlled direction mein ahista kheench kar compression-sensitive symptoms ka response dekha jata hai.

text.en: Like loosening a tight lid by lifting it slightly before turning. A little less pressure can be enough to let the movement happen.
text.ur: Jaise tight dhakkan ko ghumane se pehle thora sa upar uthate hain. Thora sa pressure kam ho jaye to aksar movement khud asaani se ho jati hai.

text.en:
Three ideas carry this whole technique:
**1.** Taking pressure off a joint can reduce pain, so traction is also a test: if it eases symptoms, the joint is probably contributing.
**2.** Light traction calms; stronger sustained traction stretches. Choose by irritability.
**3.** Direction matters: pull along the limb (long-axis) for general pressure relief, or at right angles to the joint surface (distraction) to separate surfaces.
text.ur: Traction kuch waqt ke liye joint compression aur pain kam kar sakti hai ya comfortable movement ka mauqa de sakti hai. Response har patient mein mukhtalif hota hai; lasting faide ke liye underlying functional problem ko address karna zaroori hai. Spinal traction ko radiculopathy ya disc disorders ke liye har surat mein effective nahi kehna chahiye.

question.en: Vocabulary first — clinicians use this word a lot. What does **Distraction** mean?
question.ur: Pehle vocabulary — clinicians yeh lafz bohat use karte hain. **Distraction** ka matlab kya hai?

text.en: Pulling along the length of the limb, for example pulling the arm away from the shoulder.
text.ur: Pulling along the length of the limb, for example pulling the arm away from the shoulder.

feedback.ur: Qareeb hain, lekin yeh **Long-axis traction** ka matlab hai. **Distraction** ko dobara parhein aur phir koshish karein.

text.en: Separating two joint surfaces by pulling them directly apart.
text.ur: Separating two joint surfaces by pulling them directly apart.

text.en: The joint position where tissues are most relaxed and the joint has most room.

text.en:
So when does **Manual Traction & Joint Distraction** make sense?
• Joint pain that eases when compression is removed.
• Neck or arm pain with a positive response to gentle traction, as one part of a plan.
• Preparing a stiff joint before other mobilization.
text.ur: Compression-sensitive joint pain; selected radicular presentations jin mein traction ka wazeh favorable response milta ho.

text.en:
And just as important — when you should NOT use it, or should stop:
• Instability, fracture, infection, or rheumatoid involvement of the upper neck.
• Symptoms that spread or neurological signs that worsen during traction.
• Dizziness, visual change or nausea during cervical traction.
text.ur:
Hypermobility, osteoporosis, region aur position ke mutabiq pregnancy, aur inflammatory instability.
Fracture, instability, us region mein malignancy, severe myelopathy ya progressive neurological deficit.
Traction ko har disc problem ya nerve pain ka guaranteed solution samajhna ghalat hai. Symptoms worsen hon, new tingling/weakness ho ya patient distressed ho to stop aur reassess karein; relevant joint instability ya other contraindications consider karein.

title.en: How to do it — 6 steps, each with its reason
title.ur: Kaise karein — 6 qadam, har ek ki wajah ke saath

steps.title: Screen and position
steps.detail: Place the patient in a supported, relaxed position, joint in its resting position.

steps.title: Stabilize the proximal side
steps.detail: Fix the segment closest to the body with a hand, belt or table so only the joint distal to it moves.

steps.title: Take up the slack slowly
steps.detail: Pull gently until the tissue tension just begins. This is Stage I-II.

steps.title: Hold and ask
steps.detail: Hold for a few seconds. Ask if symptoms ease, stay, or spread.

steps.title: Retest
steps.detail: Repeat the comparable movement or symptom.

beats.ur:
1. Instability, fracture, neurological aur vascular concerns ki screening karein.
2. Patient ko comfortable position dein.
3. Desired line mein distraction force dheere apply karein.
4. Symptoms ke centralize ya peripheralize hone aur comfort ko monitor karein.
5. Force ahista release karke reassess karein.

text.en: How much? Typical teaching range: gentle holds of about 10-30 seconds, repeated several times, with force kept light. Increase only if the response is good and the joint is not irritable.
text.ur: Symptoms ke response ke mutabiq brief intermittent ya sustained bouts use karein. Agar neurological symptoms barhein ya door ke hissay ki taraf phailen, to rok dein.

beats.patient: Kamran, 52, aching in the right neck and shoulder, arm symptoms eased when he rests his hand on his head.
beats.assessment: Screening is clear. Neck rotation to the right hurts at 40 degrees.
beats.treatment: In lying, you support his head, apply a gentle cervical traction for 20 seconds, three times.
beats.reassess: Rotation improves to 55 degrees without arm symptoms, so you continue gently and add posture and movement advice. If symptoms had travelled down the arm, you would have stopped.
beats.ur:
Ek misal se poora clinical flow dekhein:
Farz karein assessment ke dauran controlled unloading se patient ki familiar movement asaan hoti hai. Clinician response note karta hai aur baad mein movement dobara check karta hai. Agar symptoms barhein to traction continue nahi ki jati. Yeh illustrative example hai.

text.en:
The mistakes I see most often:
• Pulling hard and fast on an irritable joint.
• Leaving the patient in a tense position so muscles resist the pull.
• Ignoring spreading symptoms.
text.ur:
Sab se aam ghaltiyan:
• Pulling hard and fast on an irritable joint.
• Leaving the patient in a tense position so muscles resist the pull.
• Ignoring spreading symptoms.

text.en: Evidence for traction is mixed. It may give short-term relief in selected neck or arm pain patients as part of a plan with exercise, but it should not be relied on alone.
text.ur: Treatment ke baad pain, movement aur functional activity retest karein. Response variable hota hai aur traction akelay har patient ke liye effective nahi; broader management ke saath clinically justified use karein.

text.en: One line to carry into the clinic: **Less pressure, then test: if traction eases the symptom, the joint is involved.**
text.ur: Traction ko patient ke response ka test samjhein, sirf diagnosis ki bunyaad par automatic treatment nahi.
